scope: Eight additional canonical Sunseeker production generations from the 2006-2026 seed range. Existing batch-01 models are not repeated. Source dimensions are kept as published; conflicting measurement conventions are recorded in facts and uncertainties.

evidenceQualitySummary: High for official dimensions and current-page specifications on Predator 55, 76 Yacht, 82 Ocean Enclosed, Manhattan 73, and Predator 84. Moderate for legacy Manhattan 66 and Portofino 48 because model pages use different LOA measurement conventions and authorized brokerage/independent tables are required. Legacy conflicts are explicit; no conflicting dimensions were averaged. Layout evidence is clear for all eight, with documented option/configuration limits.
uncertainties: Legacy official routes may redirect to the current range index, so archived official pages and brochure mirrors are preserved as evidence targets rather than treated as live production pages.
Production dates for current 76 Yacht and current Predator 55 use independent launch/model-year evidence; current status comes from Sunseeker range listing at access time.
This batch is research-only and contains no geometry or image assets.
